text: 💡 You see it again in your mind: dusty-green diamond leaves with white mealy underside, grows in disturbed soil. Tamihana's words land on the memory like a label. Lamb's Quarters. Of course.

💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what Jerome was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.

💡 Pawpaw. The small understory tree, big drooping leaves, mango-sized green-yellow fruit you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
💡 Muscadine Grapes. The vine with thick-skinned round fruit you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Speedbump: Never stand next to it. Don't step next to it — it can't chase, so just walk around. Keep two squares away and it's furniture. When it seals up, wait it out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
